email_body:
Dear Novable Team,

I am writing to apply for the Front-end Developer Intern position at Novable. As a junior developer with hands-on experience in React, AngularJS, and WordPress, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your product team and support your mission of enabling innovation through startup relations.

In my previous role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. More recently, I have been building and maintaining websites, which has strengthened my problem-solving skills and my ability to work autonomously. I am comfortable with git version control and have basic knowledge of MySQL and MongoDB. I am also familiar with Python, which would help me understand your Django backend.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and can regularly commute to Brussels for the required two office days per week. I am eager to bring my curiosity, creativity, and sense of humor to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Novable.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Novable Team,

I am excited to apply for the Front-end Developer Intern position at Novable. As a junior developer with a strong foundation in front-end technologies and a passion for innovation, I am drawn to Novable's mission of connecting startups with corporations to drive technological progress. I believe my technical skills and proactive mindset align well with the responsibilities of this role.

During my time as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. This experience taught me how to translate complex requirements into functional, user-friendly interfaces. More recently, I have been building and maintaining websites, which has sharpened my ability to work independently and see projects through to completion. I am comfortable using git for version control and have basic knowledge of MySQL and MongoDB, which I have applied in personal projects. Additionally, I have a basic understanding of Python, which would help me navigate the Django backend used at Novable.

I am particularly attracted to the opportunity to contribute to a product that leverages AI to scout startups. My own project, mirook.com, involved implementing structured data and optimizing for AI-powered search engines, which sparked my interest in how technology can enhance innovation. I am eager to bring my curiosity, creativity, and problem-solving attitude to your team.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and can easily commute to Brussels for the required two days per week. I am available for at least three months and am ready to start immediately.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Novable's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
